name: Guard row keys and conflicting duplicates before Google Sheets import

parameters.content:
## Safe demo: no network or credentials
Run once: 3 synthetic rows become 2 keyed rows.
In Synthetic rows, set DEMONSTRATE_CONFLICT=true: validation throws.
Production: replace fixture with your data source. Keep Stop Workflow on errors. Add Google Sheets Append or Update Row after validation; match on import_key.
One batch only; this does not lock Sheets or make concurrent writes atomic. Read README.
